definitions: A Scottish surname from Scottish Gaelic.
An unincorporated community in Hamilton Township, Warren County, Ohio, United States, named after James Edward Murdoch.

blocks.text:
Murdoch is a Scottish and Irish surname and given name. An Anglicized form of the Gaelic personal names Muireadhach 'mariner', Murchadh 'sea-warrior', and Muircheartach 'sea-ruler', the first element in each being muir 'sea'.
